statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Fresh premarket evidence shows a stronger, broadly supported Nasdaq-100 futures rebound, but direct evidence of repeated failed retracements or persistent no-pullback extension is still unavailable; event and geopolitical Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail is elevated into the 12:30 UTC U.S. release cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery, with escalation dependent on the observed post-release path.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures rebound strengthens into U.S. premarket while event risk approaches
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 e-minis up 0.96% at 04:45 ET, with Alphabet and Meta more than 1% higher before the bell, the 10-year Treasury yield easing and oil falling. This aligned bullish setup raises Tail into WATCH, while the absence of verified failed-retracement structure keeps it below a blocking threshold.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail rose through the FOMC sequence, peaked at 25% at 20:00 UTC on September 16, then decayed to 19% by 09:00 UTC on September 17 as the published state returned to mixed, lower-Tail conditions.
outlookSummary: Fresh premarket alignment lifts current Tail into WATCH. Conditional Tail reaches upper WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and cash-open discovery, then decays if price action becomes two-way and meaningful retracements develop; rates and Middle East risks keep Stress high.

forecast.analysis: Latest verified premarket evidence showed Nasdaq-100 e-minis up 0.96%, with tech leaders firmer, the 10-year yield easing and oil lower. The aligned bullish setup lifts Tail to WATCH, but live pullback and failed-retracement structure is not independently verified.
